datadog-mcp-api.$comment: Identifies requests to the Datadog hosted MCP server (mcp.datadoghq.com and the regional hosts mcp.us3/us5/ap1/ap2/uk1.datadoghq.com and mcp.datadoghq.eu).

datadog-mcp-session.$comment: Open and maintain an MCP session: initialize, list tools/prompts/resources, ping, and send notifications. Required for any MCP client to function; does not read or modify Datadog content.

datadog-mcp-read-all.$comment: Run any read-only Datadog MCP tool (logs, metrics, traces, infrastructure, monitors, incidents, dashboards, security, RUM, CI, feature flags, LLM observability, DDSQL queries, documentation and other lookups) plus the MCP session handshake. Covers all toolsets, including the preview ones.

datadog-mcp-write-all.$comment: Run any Datadog MCP tool that creates, modifies, deletes, triggers or executes something (monitors, dashboards, notebooks, cases, security rules, log configuration, workflows, agents, feature flags, experiments, sandboxed code, remote actions and more) plus the MCP session handshake. Covers all toolsets, including the preview ones.

datadog-mcp-read-logs.$comment: Search logs and run SQL-style aggregations over them (search_datadog_logs, analyze_datadog_logs; also the legacy get_logs name).

datadog-mcp-read-metrics.$comment: Query metric timeseries, browse metric metadata and tags, and inspect Metrics without Limits cardinality, volume and tag-indexing configuration.

datadog-mcp-write-metrics.$comment: Create, update or delete derived metrics and change Metrics without Limits tag configurations and tag-indexing rules.

datadog-mcp-read-traces.$comment: Read APM data: fetch traces, search and aggregate spans, run read-only SQL over a trace, check service health, latency bottlenecks and APM recommendations, list sampling and service-remapping rules, and look up services in the Software Catalog (including the deprecated search_datadog_services names).

datadog-mcp-write-apm-configuration.$comment: Create, update, reorder or delete APM remote sampling rules and service remapping rules.

datadog-mcp-read-infrastructure.$comment: Inspect hosts, live processes, Kubernetes resources and rollouts, cloud resources, network monitoring (Cloud Network Monitoring, network devices, Network Path runs, AS status) and Cloud Cost recommendations.

datadog-mcp-run-remote-actions.$comment: Run actions on monitored hosts through a Private Action Runner: live Network Path traceroutes (run_network_path) and restricted read-only shell commands (datadog_remote_action_restricted_shell_run_command).

datadog-mcp-read-live-debugger.$comment: Discover where Live Debugger logpoints can run, list the logpoints of a debugger session and read captured snapshots.

datadog-mcp-write-live-debugger.$comment: Enable Live Debugger for a service, create debugger sessions and logpoints, and disable logpoints.

datadog-mcp-read-events.$comment: Search Datadog events (alerts, deployments, infrastructure changes) and Audit Trail events, and build Audit Trail queries.

datadog-mcp-read-databases.$comment: Read Database Monitoring data: find database instances, query performance, explain plans, query samples, schemas, settings, health signals, calling services and optimization recommendations.

datadog-mcp-read-profiling.$comment: Read Continuous Profiler data: profiled services, runtimes, profile types, flame graphs, call graphs, timelines, timeseries, service insights and profiling tags and fields.

datadog-mcp-read-rum.$comment: Read Real User Monitoring, Session Replay and Product Analytics data: search and aggregate RUM events, inspect applications, views, operations, RUM metrics and retention filters, search and summarize replays, and run funnel, pathway and retention analyses.

datadog-mcp-write-rum.$comment: Create, update or delete RUM operations, custom RUM metrics and RUM retention/exclusion filters (including reordering filters).

datadog-mcp-read-monitors.$comment: Search monitors, monitor groups and SLOs, validate monitor definitions, browse monitor templates and find monitoring coverage gaps.

datadog-mcp-write-monitors.$comment: Create monitors (created in draft mode, create_datadog_monitor).

datadog-mcp-read-investigations.$comment: Read incidents, Bits AI investigations and Watchdog anomaly data: incident details, investigation findings, Watchdog stories and insights, influential tags, external provider outages, timeseries jump detection and forecasts.

datadog-mcp-write-investigations.$comment: Trigger Bits AI investigations for alerts, incidents or free-text descriptions, and steer running investigations.

datadog-mcp-read-cases.$comment: Read Work Management cases: search cases, view details, attachments, links and projects, and look up Datadog users.

datadog-mcp-write-cases.$comment: Create and update Work Management cases, add comments and attachments, link cases to each other or to Jira issues, and create projects.

datadog-mcp-read-error-tracking.$comment: Search and inspect Error Tracking issues, run SQL-style analysis over error samples and read issue analytics.

datadog-mcp-write-error-tracking.$comment: Change the state or assignee of Error Tracking issues and manage their comments and Jira/Linear/case links.

datadog-mcp-read-dashboards.$comment: Read dashboards, notebooks, widgets and Datadog spreadsheets: search and fetch them, render and verify widgets, validate widget and notebook cell definitions, and consult widget-building reference material.

datadog-mcp-write-dashboards.$comment: Create or update dashboards, notebooks and Datadog spreadsheets, and restore soft-deleted notebooks.

datadog-mcp-delete-dashboards.$comment: Delete dashboards, notebooks and Datadog spreadsheets.

datadog-mcp-read-logs-configuration.$comment: Read log pipelines, indexes and archives, and list, describe and validate Observability Pipelines configurations.

datadog-mcp-write-logs-configuration.$comment: Create, update, reorder or delete log pipelines, indexes and archives, and create Observability Pipelines.

datadog-mcp-read-security.$comment: Read security data: search and analyze security signals, findings and IoC indicators, read detection rules, suppressions, findings automation rules, App & API Protection passlists, denylists, custom WAF rules and blocking config, read IaC custom rules, generate and validate IaC rule Rego without saving it, and scan code for hardcoded secrets.

datadog-mcp-write-security.$comment: Change security configuration and triage: triage signals and IoC indicators, create/update/delete detection rules, suppressions and findings automation rules, mute, assign, re-prioritize or ticket findings, manage App & API Protection passlists, denylists and custom WAF rules, and create, update, publish or delete IaC custom rules.

datadog-mcp-read-governance.$comment: Read organization governance data: insights, controls, detections, rate and resource limits, best practices and tag rules.

datadog-mcp-write-governance.$comment: Mitigate or update governance detections and create, update or delete tag rules.

datadog-mcp-read-software-delivery.$comment: Read CI Visibility, Test Optimization, code coverage, DORA deployment metrics, Deployment Gates and Synthetic tests.

datadog-mcp-write-software-delivery.$comment: Quarantine or disable flaky tests and create or edit Synthetic HTTP API tests.

datadog-mcp-read-feature-flags.$comment: Read feature flags, their environments and allocations, check flag implementation in code, and read experiments, their results, diagnostics and metric definitions.

datadog-mcp-write-feature-flags.$comment: Create feature flags, change flag configuration and allocations per environment, and create, start, conclude or cancel experiments.

datadog-mcp-read-data-observability.$comment: Read the data catalog and Data Observability: search data entities, lineage and hierarchy, warehouse query history, data quality monitors and coverage, entity tags and descriptions, Spark job health and recommendations.

datadog-mcp-write-data-observability.$comment: Set custom tags and descriptions on data catalog entities.

datadog-mcp-read-llm-observability.$comment: Read LLM / Agent Observability data: search traces and spans, agent loops and insights, experiments and their results, evaluators and evaluations, projects, datasets, Patterns configs and results, and annotation queues.

datadog-mcp-write-llm-observability.$comment: Change LLM / Agent Observability data: create experiments, update insight status and submit feedback, create, update or delete evaluators, add dataset records, create or update Patterns configs and trigger Patterns runs, and manage annotation queues, label schemas, interactions and annotations.

datadog-mcp-run-ddsql-queries.$comment: Run read-only DDSQL queries over Datadog data, browse DDSQL tables, columns and fields, read saved queries and generate DDSQL Editor links.

datadog-mcp-write-ddsql-saved-queries.$comment: Create or update saved DDSQL queries.

datadog-mcp-read-reference-tables.$comment: List Reference Tables and read their rows.

datadog-mcp-write-reference-tables.$comment: Create Reference Tables and append or upsert rows in them.

datadog-mcp-read-automation.$comment: Read Workflow Automation workflows, actions and execution history, Bits AI agents and their conversations, Forms and their responses, and Datadog Assistant conversation history.

datadog-mcp-write-automation.$comment: Create, update, publish or unpublish workflows, create and configure Bits AI agents (including their managed MCP servers), and create, update, publish or clone Forms.

datadog-mcp-run-automation.$comment: Execute or cancel workflow runs, run Bits AI agents, and send messages to the Datadog Assistant (Bits Chat).

datadog-mcp-execute-code.$comment: Run agent-written JavaScript in a Datadog-managed sandbox with access to Datadog APIs (execute_code); the code can read or write any Datadog resource the user has access to.

datadog-mcp-read-documentation.$comment: Search and read Datadog documentation, look up the code-execution SDK reference, and follow product onboarding guides (RUM, devices, Kubernetes, Agent Observability, Test Optimization, serverless, source maps).
